t: The Milwaukee Fixtec Gen 2 M14 Universal Nut for Angle Grinders is an essential accessory for trade professionals, enabling rapid, tool-free disc changes. This universal angle grinder nut is ideal for busy tradespeople on construction sites and in workshops, where quick disc swaps are crucial for productivity. It fits universal angle grinders from 115mm to 230mm, including those with automatic or rapid braking systems, allowing disc changes in as little as 12 seconds without tools. The ultra-slim 8mm profile maximises usable disc surface and improves access in restricted areas. Constructed from durable carbon steel, it features integrated keyholes for spanner removal if overtightening occurs, ensuring reliability and ease of use for any Milwaukee angle grinder.
